title: Reliquary round 2: lit port, dark metallic crimson (12)
desc: From J's 612 picks: KEEP R2a, R4a, R4b; IMPROVE R1c, R6c, R2b ("Cant see the port on any of these, maybe want darker red ... near metallic like the dark lantern"). Every take: the port 1.5x, raised and lit. Two of each: 1 green, 2 near-black metallic crimson with polished gold. Stills at frame 118, the port facing you.
